notes.title: First Person Camera Mode
notes.content:
The next update will be very large and will bring a lot of innovations and changes.

But there is one thing that is currently in doubt - the first-person camera mode. Some people showed interest in this feature, and I would like to ask - would you like to see the first-person camera mode in the game?

notes.title: Test of new mutants for future big update 0.0.2.2
notes.content:
A video in which two new types of mutants are tested, which will appear in the upcoming big update - 0.0.2.2

The first of them - Phantom, knows how to turn its skin into a camouflage field, which gives it a great advantage, but it can be noticed by air distortions, moreover, its masking is not infinite.
The second one - Shooter, a big and clumsy bruiser shooting with bursts and having strong armor in closed spaces can become a serious problem for the player.

[previewyoutube=pnr82IdxdCA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Future of The Project "Treater"
notes.content:
I welcome all those interested in this project.

I would like to say that the game is developed by one person, and it is difficult for me to track all the problems and shortcomings of the game. I have a project development plan, but...I ask those who are dissuaded by something to play the game - to tell here exactly what you did not like and why.

[b]I, in turn, will try to fix it.[/b]

[b]P.S.[/b] And thanks to those who have already contributed and provided feedback on the game, if not for you, some bugs would not have been fixed yet. :)


[b]P.S.S[/b] New update coming soon :)

notes.title: Announcing BIG Update v.0.0.1.0 [Early Access]
notes.content:
In the next update v.0.0.1.0, a lot of new content will appear, the debuff system will be finalized, and a system will also appear for the NPC to arrive at the player’s base.

With this update, a lot of new items, weapons, crafting recipes will appear in the game + new locations will be open in a new update.

Well and, of course, there will be many bug fixes. ;)

The update will be released soon.

notes.title: Announcing Update v.0.0.0.2 [Early Access]
notes.content:
In the next update v.0.0.0.2, a wardrobe will appear, and with it three types of suits and three types of armor. Some will give resistance to some kind of debuff, and some will simply increase damage protection.

Also, the player’s base will be slightly expanded, and new moves will appear. + The mechanics of attacking the base will appear. Monsters will be able to destroy your buildings, so be prepared. ;)

The update will be released within a few days.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35601777/37e74864ad72b3f43ff9de18837263d7bde4929a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Coming soon update!
notes.content:
Soon, an update will be released for the game adding new content, new mechanics, as well as fixing some bugs.

If you notice some kind of bug or flaw, please let me know about it. :)

notes.title: Treater is now release in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hardline of sci-fi survival on Space Station! Craft, Research, Explore and Fight against evolving mutants. Interesting open world and big sectors to explore! Manage the entire colony single-handed! Can you survive long enough to escape the horror?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35601777/c845fc712cec656e25236257532d73ce0aa0b122.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Welcome to Treater STORE page :)
notes.content:
I would like to welcome everyone to Treater store page! Release date for early access is 26th August 2019.

I'm very excited yet feel responsible for what the future will bring, and I will do our absolute best to complete the game into full release state.

I hope for Community feedback. Suggestions will be taken seriously, changes will be made and be reflected in updates throughout the process.
